events.desc: Dick Dastardly: Ah, what a MAGNIFICENT establishment! Doily Manor — I knew the family, of course. Distant cousins on my mother's side. Terribly wealthy, terribly dead, terribly generous with their inheritance — TO ME, naturally. Now then, let's see who's been signing in, shall we? One must observe the proper formalities before one claims what is rightfully one's own!

That guest book could have clues — previous visitors, perhaps a hint about where the valuables are kept. And I've got my fake medal ready for when I need to impress someone into doing my bidding. First things first — intelligence gathering. Let the rabble mill about while Reginald Foxworth does what Reginald Foxworth does best.

Reginald Foxworth ALWAYS gets the treasure. Always. Well... eventually. THIS time, certainly!

I suggest you ALL rush to the kitchen at once — every last one of you! Heave that stove aside! Dig up those flagstones! Chop chop! Time is of the essence, my dear fellow treasure hunters! Almost.

Time to take my final bow and wait. Just... wait. In the quiet. With my recipes. And my pride.
